prompt.project_info: Create a realistic night outdoor parking-lot selfie of an approved adult Asian woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult Asian woman with long shiny black hair, thin silver-framed glasses, Douyin-inspired natural makeup, rosy cheeks, dark manicure, and confident direct gaze, wearing an opaque black one-shoulder top with secure coverage and a brown-gold fabric belt bow, holding a round black lollipop casually.
prompt.composition_elements: High-angle selfie from above, phone held in right hand, lollipop in left, gray concrete with white parking lines, unbranded black luxury sports car grille in background, dim street lamps and distant city lights.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dim nocturnal street lighting with soft reflections on glasses and hair, candid confident mood, realistic low-light texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-quality smartphone selfie, upper-body framing, natural proportions, realistic city-night color and subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic high-angle night selfie of an approved adult Asian woman with long shiny black hair, thin silver-framed eyeglasses, natural Douyin-inspired makeup, rosy cheeks, dark manicure, and a confident direct gaze. She wears an opaque black one-shoulder top with secure coverage and a brown-and-gold striped fabric belt tied in a bow, holding a round black lollipop casually in her left hand and a phone in her right. The outdoor parking lot has grey concrete, white parking lines, an unbranded black luxury sports car grille, dim street lamps, and distant city lights. Use realistic low-light smartphone photography, soft reflections on hair and glasses, natural proportions, and subtle grain. Keep the lollipop gesture casual and non-suggestive.
